response.sql: WITH race_name_totals AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total FROM race_name_totals), above_average AS (SELECT t.name, t.total_points, t.total_points - a.avg_total AS excess_points FROM race_name_totals AS t CROSS JOIN overall_average AS a WHERE t.total_points > a.avg_total) SELECT (SELECT SUM(total_points) FROM above_average) AS combined_total_points, (SELECT AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) FROM above_average AS a JOIN races AS r ON r.name = a.name JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId) AS average_laps_completed, (SELECT AVG(excess_points) FROM above_average) AS average_excess_points;
